# Scrapling MCP bundle for DeepSeek Harness

Wraps the MCP server that ships with Scrapling so the
agent gets Scrapling's 18 scraping tools (`mcp
__scrapling__*`) in every session.

This bundle contains no runtime code of its own — it only inserts the generic MCP client
(`@deepseek
-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) pointed at the `scrapling-mcp` console script.
## What it adds
| Group | Tools |

| HTTP (no JS) | `make_request`, `open_request_session`, `session_make_request` |
| One-shot browser

| `browser_fetch_once` |
| Browser sessions | `browser_open`, `browser_fetch`, `browser_extract`, `
browser_actions`, `browser_evaluate`, `browser_screenshot`, `browser_observe`, `browser_network_requ

ests`, `browser_network_request`, `browser_save_state`, `browser_load_state` |
| Housekeeping | `lis
t_sessions`, `close_session` |
## Host prerequisites

- Python 3.10+ with `scrapling[ai]` (the extras pull in the MCP server dependencies):
`pip install "

scrapling[ai]"`
- A Chromium-compatible browser. This machine has no Playwright/Patchright download,

so
`cordis.patch.yml` passes `--executable-path` pointing at the locally installed Chrome:
`C:/Prog

ram Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe`. Change that path if Chrome lives
elsewhere, or run
`scrapling install` and drop the argument to use a downloaded Chromium.
## Files

- `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the MCP client entry `scrapling-mcp` (stdio transport).
- `package.js

on` — bundle metadata (`dsh.bundle.patch`, exported locale + icon).
- `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.j

son` — plugin inventory title/description.
- `icon.svg` — inventory icon.
## Install / update

Install with the harness plugin manager (agent tool `plugin_manager`, action `install_bundle`)
or th
e desktop plugin page, pointing at this directory:

The profile links this directory (`@local/scrapling-mcp` → this folder), so editing
`cordis.patch.ym

l` takes effect after the entry is disabled and re-enabled (or after the app
restarts) — the MCP cli
ent is only configured at entry load time.
## Portability (read before installing on a different machine)
`cordis.patch.yml` contains two absolute paths from the author's Windows host:

- `command`: the `scrapling-mcp` console script (the Python `Scripts` directory).
- `args[1]`: `--ex
ecutable-path` for a Chromium-compatible browser.

On another machine, edit both values to match your own Python and browser locations,
or put `scrapli

ng-mcp` on PATH and set `command` to `scrapling-mcp` with no `args`.
Everything else in the bundle i

PATH and set `command` to `scrapling-mcp` with no `args`.
Everything else in the bundle is portable.
